compiled_state.title: Create ADR 0014: consolidate workflow-mode config into dso.workflow (hybrid shim + migrator rationale)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context
Story: 5ed3-9eb5-b841-4b5f — Update project docs to reflect dso.workflow config consolidation
Parent epic: 3b8b-d7e1-eeff-4796

## What to do
Create a new ADR in `docs/adr/` documenting the architectural decision to consolidate workflow-mode config into a single `dso.workflow` key.

- File: `docs/adr/0014-dso-workflow-config-consolidation.md`
- ADR format: follow the style of existing ADRs in docs/adr/ (Status, Context, Decision, Consequences sections)
- Content must cover:
  - Context: 4 separate config keys (merge.strategy, enforcement.strategy, worktree.isolation_enabled, attribution.enabled) all map to a binary workflow mode
  - Decision: consolidate into single `dso.workflow=ci-pr|local` key
  - Rationale for hybrid shim approach: backward-compatible read-config.sh inline shim handles legacy keys transparently during migration window
  - Rationale for idempotent migrator: migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh rewrites dso-config.conf and creates sentinel file
  - Consequences: simplified config, sentinel lockout after migration, legacy keys become errors post-migration

## Testing mode
GREEN — doc-only change, no executable behavior

## Done Definitions (from story)
- A new ADR in docs/adr/ documents the decision to consolidate workflow-mode config into a single key and the rationale for the hybrid shim + migrator approach

## Notes
- Follow doc-router.md Gate 4 (decision rationale)
- Check the next ADR number by listing docs/adr/ to confirm 0014 is correct
